fact: The July 2026 WFP Chad rainy-season monitoring bulletin (update to the third dekad of June 2026) reports vegetation anomaly from MODIS NDVI and CHIRPS satellite rainfall, with ANAM seasonal forecasts, as a recurring seasonal product.
title: Bulletin de suivi de la saison pluvieuse, Saison 2026 (mise à jour de Juin 2026 (3-ème décade)
